name: poker-platform
description: Real-time multiplayer Texas Hold'em between human players, with play chips that have no cash value

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @poker/server" "npm run dev -w @poker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @poker/shared && npm run build -w @poker/engine && npm run build -w @poker/server && npm run build -w @poker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:db: npm run build:core && npm run test:db -w @poker/server
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @poker/shared && npm run build -w @poker/engine
